title: Costs of Arbitrary Real Matrix Factorizations for Pure-DP Continual Counting
summary: Let $T_n$ be the lower-triangular prefix-sum matrix and let $c_{\mathrm{F}}(T_n)$ and $c_2(T_n)$ be the factorization costs that govern the mean and maximum per-coordinate squared error of the Laplace matrix mechanism under pure $\varepsilon$-differential privacy, for $\varepsilon>0$. We prove $c_{\mathrm{F}}(T_n),c_2(T_n)=Θ((\log(n+1))^{3/2})$ with no sign, sparsity, or squareness restriction and with arbitrary finite inner dimension.
